description: This file defines the BasketViewModelService class, which implements methods for retrieving, creating, and mapping shopping basket data in an e-commerce web application. It interacts with repositories and services to manage basket items, generate view models, and count total items for a user.

classes.name: BasketViewModelService
classes.description: Service class managing shopping basket view models, including retrieval, creation, and mapping of basket data, and counting items for a user.

methods.name: GetOrCreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Retrieves the basket for a user or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: CreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Creates a new basket for the specified user.

methods.name: GetBasketItems
methods.description: Fetches detailed basket item view models, including product information and image URLs.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Maps a Basket entity to a BasketViewModel.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in a user's basket.
